notes.title: Exciting New Adventure Approaches! Join the Development of Bullwagon Business!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44769971/dd80ceae91a3747e1393b18857d02b56111d2a86.png[/img]

Exciting new adventure is approaching! In our medieval trading simulation game, where you travel through kingdoms with a wagon and a bull, exciting things are still happening! Although we are still in development, we have just completed a new combat system and improved archery, so you can feel like a true hero. Our AI is also fully functional, meaning your opponents will be smart and ready to give you a tough fight! Keep an eye on us as we continuously work on further improvements and updates! Bullwagon Business is still expanding, and you can be a part of this thrilling adventure!
